integrity: The result contains an explicit analytical derivation and a finite numerical diagnostic. The diagnostic is not a proof of an infinite-array limit. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The wavenumber Cesaro mean precedes the infinite-array limit; no energy-weighted mean, uniform geometry limit, disorder, loss, or pointwise in-band transmission limit is claimed. The normalized scattering formula is inherited from the cited preprint; priority against all historical transfer-matrix specializations is not independently settled.
title: An exact broadband-transmission law for incommensurate quantum-graph resonator arrays
